source_reference.supports: 3-axis machining can use multiple workpiece setups; file +Z alone does not prove a part impossible.

limits: Mesh geometry does not certify tool/holder clearance, fixturing, threading or the complete manufacturing process.
Curved-source geometry without analytic associations or a tessellation-error bound remains unverified.
Eight dominant planar facets bound setup candidates; other orientations can remain unverified.
Convex nearest-surface batches reuse the existing candidate budget; it is a soft cap if one hull alone exceeds a configured budget. Default analysis-face cap is below the default budget.

Separate forging/molding draft and pull-direction heuristics remain orientation-dependent and require follow-up. Native aligned/tilted forging verdicts still differ because of that independent draft check.
Real services, customer/physical accuracy, security, approved production rollout and the full feature ledger remain incomplete.
